name: ch18_part1_meaning_of_secularism
prompt: Vibrant educational political cartoon explaining the core meaning of secularism (धर्मनिरपेक्षता) in India. In the center, the Indian Constitution glowing brightly with equal respect to all religions (Hinduism, Islam, Christianity, Sikhism, Buddhism, Jainism), preventing both inter-religious and intra-religious domination. Heading 'धर्मनिरपेक्षता: सभी धर्मों का समान सम्मान' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. Rich and peaceful colors.

name: ch18_part2_two_types_of_domination
prompt: Educational political cartoon showing two types of religious domination: 1. Inter-religious domination (one religious group dominating another), 2. Intra-religious domination (priestly hierarchy dominating women or lower castes within the same religion). Heading 'धार्मिक वर्चस्व के दो रूप: अंतर व अंतः-धार्मिक' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. High detail educational chart.

name: ch18_part3_theocratic_vs_secular_state
prompt: Comparative educational political cartoon comparing a Theocratic State (धर्मतांत्रिक राज्य) having an official state religion and religious laws versus a Secular Democratic State (धर्मनिरपेक्ष राज्य) where state has no official religion and treats all citizens equally under constitutional law. Clear Hindi labels 'धर्मतांत्रिक राज्य' and 'धर्मनिरपेक्ष राज्य'. High detail educational poster.

name: ch18_part4_western_model_separation
prompt: Educational political cartoon showing the Western Model of Secularism (धर्मनिरपेक्षता का पश्चिमी मॉडल). A thick stone wall of separation between Church/Religion on one side and State/Government on the other, showing strict mutual non-interference. Heading 'पश्चिमी मॉडल: धर्म और राज्य का पूर्ण अलगाव' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. High detail educational poster.

name: ch18_part5_western_model_limitations
prompt: Educational political cartoon showing the limitations of the Western model of secularism: because of strict non-interference, the state cannot ban social evils like untouchability, caste discrimination, or child marriage within religious groups. Heading 'पश्चिमी धर्मनिरपेक्षता की सीमाएं' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. High detail, thoughtful educational poster.

name: ch18_part6_principled_distance_indian_model
prompt: Clear educational political cartoon illustrating the concept of 'Principled Distance' (सैद्धांतिक दूरी) in Indian Secularism by Prof. Rajeev Bhargava. The Indian democratic state maintaining equal distance from all religions, but intervening positively to ban untouchability and protect women's equal rights. Heading 'भारतीय मॉडल: सैद्धांतिक दूरी की संकल्पना' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. High detail educational poster.

name: ch18_part7_western_vs_indian_comparison
prompt: Educational comparison chart political cartoon comparing Western Secularism (strict wall of separation, individual rights only) versus Indian Secularism (principled distance, equality of all religions, minority community rights, state-led social reforms). Clear Hindi labels 'पश्चिमी मॉडल' and 'भारतीय मॉडल'. High detail, balanced educational chart.

name: ch18_part8_freedom_of_religion_art25_28
prompt: Educational political cartoon showing Fundamental Right to Freedom of Religion under Articles 25 to 28 of the Indian Constitution. A golden temple, mosque, church, and gurdwara under the protective arch of the Constitution, allowing freedom of conscience, practice, and propagation. Heading 'धार्मिक स्वतंत्रता का अधिकार: अनुच्छेद 25 से 28' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. Rich poster style.

name: ch18_part9_minority_rights_art29_30
prompt: Educational political cartoon showing minority cultural and educational rights under Articles 29 and 30 of the Indian Constitution. Minority communities (linguistic and religious) managing their schools, preserving their scripts, language, and culture under the protective shield of the Constitution. Heading 'अल्पसंख्यकों के अधिकार: अनुच्छेद 29 व 30' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. High detail, poster style.

name: ch18_part10_criticisms_and_responses
prompt: Educational political cartoon showing the 42nd Constitutional Amendment 1976 and the Supreme Court S.R. Bommai case establishing Secularism (पंथनिरपेक्षता) as the indestructible Basic Structure of the Indian Constitution. Heading 'संविधान का मूल ढांचा: पंथनिरपेक्षता' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. High detail poster style.

name: ch18_part11_anti_religious_criticism
prompt: Educational political cartoon dispelling the myth that Indian secularism is 'anti-religious' (धर्म-विरोधी). The Constitution shown nurturing people of all faiths in prayer while eliminating superstition and hatred. Heading 'धर्म-विरोधी नहीं: सद्भाव व स्वतंत्रता का रक्षक' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. High detail poster.

name: ch18_part12_western_import_criticism
prompt: Historical cultural cartoon proving that secularism in India is rooted in ancient tradition of 'Sarva Dharma Sambhava' (सर्वधर्म समभाव), Emperor Ashoka's edicts of religious tolerance, and Saint Kabir. Heading 'पश्चिमी आयात नहीं: प्राचीन भारतीय सहिष्णुता की विरासत' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. Rich historical poster.

name: ch18_part13_minoritarianism_criticism
prompt: Thoughtful political cartoon explaining why protecting minority rights is not appeasement (तुष्टीकरण) but an essential constitutional shield to ensure equal citizenship and dignity in a democracy. Heading 'समानता का सुरक्षा कवच: न कि तुष्टीकरण' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. High detail educational poster.

name: ch18_part14_interventionist_criticism
prompt: Empowering political cartoon justifying state intervention for social reform: abolishing child marriage, untouchability, and ensuring women's entry and rights. Heading 'सकारात्मक सुधार: मानवीय गरिमा की रक्षा' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. High detail poster style.

name: ch18_part15_vote_bank_politics_criticism
prompt: Democratic political cartoon showing enlightened voters rejecting communal vote-bank polarization and demanding education, healthcare, and employment from politicians. Heading 'वोट बैंक से ऊपर: विकास व अधिकारों की राजनीति' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. High detail poster.

name: ch18_part16_impossible_project_criticism
prompt: Celebratory political cartoon showing 75+ years of vibrant Indian democracy proving that a diverse multi-religious society thrives peacefully through secularism. Heading 'असंभव नहीं: 75+ वर्षों की सफल लोकतांत्रिक यात्रा' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. High detail poster.

name: ch18_part17_gender_justice_reforms
prompt: Modern progressive judicial cartoon showing the Supreme Court upholding gender justice (Shayara Bano Triple Talaq & Sabarimala rulings) under Articles 14 and 21. Heading 'पंथ सुधार व लैंगिक न्याय: समानता की विजय' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. High detail poster.

name: ch18_part18_interfaith_dialogue_harmony
prompt: Inspiring community cartoon showing interfaith dialogue (अंतर-धार्मिक संवाद): leaders and youth of Hindu, Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Buddhist communities sharing festival sweets and working together on social welfare. Heading 'अंतर-धार्मिक संवाद: भाईचारा व सौहार्द' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. Warm poster style.

name: ch18_part19_digital_harmony_fact_check
prompt: High-tech civic education cartoon showing citizens using fact-checking magnifying glass to stop communal fake news and rumors on social media, spreading peace and unity online. Heading 'डिजिटल युग में सद्भाव: अफवाहों पर रोक' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. High detail poster.

name: ch18_part20_conclusion_sarva_dharma_sambhav
prompt: Grand conclusion patriotic cartoon: Golden Ashoka Lion Capital, Indian Constitution, and fluttering Tricolor in center, surrounded by united Indian citizens of all faiths living in harmony. Banner 'सर्वधर्म समभाव ही राष्ट्र की शक्ति' and 'सत्यमेव जयते' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. Majestic high detail poster.
